title: Reproduce an exact Miura elliptic-curve addition

source.citation: Joe Suzuki, Miura: Divisor Class Group Arithmetic, arXiv:1512.08040

translation.notes: Noether directly models the elliptic curve y^2=x^3+3x used by the source transcript and reproduces the two-point divisor-class sum. The general Miura standard-basis algorithm and ideal representatives are not claimed.
